The joy of music

I think the power of music is not just on how it affects our emotions. It’s about connecting and paying respect to our species.

Sun Aug 06 2023

Recently I came across this remarkable collaboration between a few great contemporary musicians. I was deeply moved by the way how music flows from one to the the other.

Music is beyond the expression of human emotion and resonance. It’s another dimension out of octaves of harmonics.
